requirements.note: Bachelor's degree; GPA2.75 overall undergraduate and3.0 biological-sciences coursework. Catalog and department request general GRE (no departmental minimum); central policy no longer requires it, and2026 handbook omits it. Use department's stricter published rule and confirm. Major professor required; contact before application strongly advised. Lower English scores may entail ESL; confirm department approval.

funding.note: Research/teaching/service assistantships available, with faculty sponsorship, credentials, teaching needs and funds considered. Satisfactory progress and enrollment required; no universal guarantee.
